page_title: ROM 2-0 NAP | AS Roma v Napoli 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.

90+6' 2 - 0 GOAL! A great pass finds Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 2:0.
90+5' Booking. Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) receives a caution from the referee.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Walter Mazzarri prepares a substitution. Juan Jesus is replaced by Natan (Napoli).
88' Piotr Zielinski comes off the pitch to be replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Napoli).
87' Substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia makes way for Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
86' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) picks up his second yellow card from referee Andrea Colombo and is given his marching orders.
85' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
84' The resulting corner, taken by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), comes to nothing.
82' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
81' Here is a change. Piotr Zielinski is going off and Walter Mazzarri gives the last tactical orders to Alessandro Zanoli (Napoli).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alessio Zerbin (Napoli) will replace Mario Rui.
79' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) crosses the ball from the free kick, but his attempt is overhit and it goes well out of play.
79' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) touches the ball with his hand. That's a free kick to Napoli.
76' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
76' 1 - 0 Goal! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Stephan El Shaarawy, then sends the ball into the top right corner. 1:0.
75' Jose Mourinho has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Zeki Celik (AS Roma) replacing Rasmus Kristensen.
71' Andrea Belotti will be replaced by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
71' Jose Mourinho decides to make a substitution. Leandro Paredes will be replaced by Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).
71' Substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) has come on for Nicola Zalewski.
70' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Matteo Politano (Napoli) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
66' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
63' The ball is cleared after Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
62' Juan Jesus (Napoli) picks up a yellow card.
62' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
60' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
58' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
58' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) jumps into a tackle and Andrea Colombo signals a foul.
57' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
56' Stanislav Lobotka is being substituted because of an injury. Walter Mazzarri sends Jens Cajuste (Napoli) on the pitch.

55' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Rui Patricio pulls off an easy save.
54' Mario Rui (Napoli) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
53' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) picks out Romelu Lukaku with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
52' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
51' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
49' AS Roma are ruled offside.
48' A pass finds the feet of Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
47' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) and Frank Anguissa combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
46' Referee Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45+3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli).
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

45' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is behind the touchline and Napoli will take a throw-in.
45' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
44' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
40' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
40' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul. Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
38' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
38' The resulting corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is cleared by the defence.
37' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' PENALTY APPEAL after Victor Osimhen (Napoli) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
35' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
34' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
32' The game is interrupted now, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
32' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
32' Referee Andrea Colombo has finally had enough of Jose Mourinho and brandishes a yellow card at him!
32' Walter Mazzarri isn't happy on the touchline after referee Andrea Colombo shows him a yellow card.
30' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
29' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
28' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
28' Mario Rui (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.

21' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Alex Meret blocks the shot with his legs.
19' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
19' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Edoardo Bove (AS Roma). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the crossbar and is cleared to safety.
17' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
16' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) picks up an injury.
14' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
12' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
10' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
8' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for AS Roma.
8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
4' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Andrea Colombo no option but to blow his whistle.
2' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

Napoli will kick the game off.
Andrea Colombo will referee today's match.
